title: Leap Core
body:
This mod adds the "Leap Core".

Recipe:

![Crafting Recipe (Left and right columns: green wool, top and bottom middle: emerald, middle: wind charge](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a3670ce15acdf4623dd7fb9bb81ed50896a2290b_0.webp)

Because of it's fine-tuning ability, it's optimal for elytra launchers, indoor elevators and more.

Cancels fall damage.
